info.title: WoTEx Tracker service
info.description: Authenticated imported-observation service with deterministic structured, paged and saved measurement queries, snapshot-pinned gap-honest route replay from retained private evidence, persisted rule status and administrator-managed heartbeat, battery, motion and geofence rule definitions evaluated against committed Thing evidence, acknowledgeable rule alerts listed per Thing for defined rules, administrator unenrollment, pinned incident snapshots and an administrator credential inventory. No scanner, notification delivery or physical interaction is implied.

get.description: Lists, in credential ID order, the host-configured credentials that grant any permission in this scope, with that scope's permissions, expiry and durable revocation at the current committed generation. Requires admin authority. Token digests, secret keys and other scopes' grants are never returned. A revocation whose credential ID is no longer configured is not listed.

post.description: Evaluate a closed numeric measurement query against one authorized committed SQLite snapshot. This read-only POST does not use an Idempotency-Key. At most eight queries execute at once, two per principal, with sixteen starts per principal per second. Caller loss, store shutdown or the configured deadline cancels the dedicated read connection. Pagination and prompt translation are not provided by this operation.

requestBody.description: At most 1 MiB, UTF-8 JSON; duplicate keys and unknown fields are rejected.

post.description: Evaluate one bounded bucket page at the first request's committed generation. The encrypted cursor binds the exact query, page size, principal, scope and generation for seven days. Every continuation repeats the exact query and rechecks current read authority; later commits are excluded. This read-only POST does not use an Idempotency-Key. Query concurrency, rate, deadline and cancellation limits still apply.

requestBody.description: At most 1 MiB, UTF-8 JSON; duplicate keys and unknown fields are rejected.

post.description: Project one bounded retained-evidence page into gap-honest route segments at the first request's committed generation. The encrypted cursor binds the exact Thing, time window, clock and quality policy, gap limits, page size, principal, scope and generation for seven days. Every continuation rechecks current read authority. Public points preserve qualified coordinates, source, quality, stated accuracy and time basis while pseudonymizing private evidence identities. Missing or ambiguous position materialisations and rejected samples remain explicit and split segments. This read-only POST does not use an Idempotency-Key.

Pages, newest first, the alerts of rules defined through the service for one Thing at a cursor-bound committed snapshot. Requires read authority. The cursor binds the Thing and page size. Alerts of host-managed and event-only rules have no Thing and are omitted; an unknown Thing has none.
Lists, in ID order, the at most eight live rule definitions bound to one Thing at the current committed snapshot. Requires read authority. An unknown Thing has no definitions.

Reads, in definition ID order, the committed status of every live rule definition bound to one Thing, identified as kind:id and read at the same committed generation as the definitions. Requires read authority. A definition without recorded status is omitted; an unknown Thing has none.

schema.description: Native JSON scalar constrained by the selected TD Property. Unavailable measurements return 503, never a numeric null. Requires read authority.

X-Wotex-Generation.description: Committed snapshot generation shared by TD and state

schema.description: Bounded SSE of native JSON scalars constrained by the selected observable TD Property. Without a cursor, sends the current committed value and then every committed Thing update. Supply at most one cursor or Last-Event-ID to resume after an acknowledged sample. The id field is an encrypted cursor bound to principal, scope, Thing and Property. The event field is property:snapshot:<generation>:<generation> for the initial sample, or property:event:<event-id>:<generation> for an update; this stable metadata supports deduplication. The data field contains only the native Property value, without an envelope. No physical sensor subscription or automatic reconnect is implied. Requires read authority; missing returns 404, unavailable 503, unsupported 501 before headers. Authorization, availability gaps, retention or storage failures close an established stream. Use a fresh snapshot after a gap or expired cursor. At most 300 seconds, 32 KiB per frame, 16 instance-wide streams shared with events/stream; polling is at most one second.

post.description: Requires admin authority. Removes one enrolled asset from current views in one commit: its enrollment, Thing, current state and every live rule definition bound to it become deletion tombstones, so those rules stop scheduling. Record history, private evidence, observations and alerts are retained. No publication or physical Action is requested.

get.description: Execute an absolute definition exactly, or resolve a rolling definition to an admitted absolute from-inclusive/to-exclusive window ending one millisecond after the current host time. The returned QueryResult records the resolved bounds and identity. Current read authority is checked again for the underlying dataset; possession or sharing of a definition grants no data access. The model is not called. Query concurrency, refresh-rate, deadline and cancellation limits still apply.

Pages the caller's own unexpired operation receipts in this scope, newest first by commit generation and then operation ID. Requires read authority. The cursor binds the first page's generation, principal and page size, so later commits are excluded. Only committed outcomes have receipts, and receipts expire seven days after they were recorded.

schema.description: SSE: event tracker has Event JSON data. id is the encrypted transport cursor; deduplicate data.id. An initial ready event has schema wtr.stream.v1 and cursor; comment heartbeats carry no domain event. Supply exactly one of cursor or Last-Event-ID. Errors before headers are JSON. After headers, authorization/retention/storage failure closes the connection. Resnapshot on expired cursors. Connection lifetime 300 s; idle reauthorization/poll 1 s; no unlimited queue.

Thing.description: TD 1.1, additionally validated by Wotex.ThingDescription; extensions are preserved.

SnapshotWindow.description: Incident snapshot. The query's absolute bounds are rerun at the pinned committed generation, which must equal the save request's expected_generation, and must reproduce result_identity. A later execution that cannot reproduce it returns revision_mismatch.

RuleStatus.description: Reviewed status of one persisted deterministic rule. Observations, evidence bundles, samples and coordinates are not included; times and numeric policy values use the tagged Scalar form.

Credential.description: Administrator-only audit projection of one host-configured credential in the requested scope. Status is revoked when a durable revocation exists, otherwise expired at the service's receiver time or active.

MotionRuleParameters.description: Stationary thresholds must not exceed moving thresholds, and moving speed must not exceed the plausible-speed limit. Position input is evaluated only when the committed evidence has exactly one position; the service does not select a source implicitly.

GeofenceRuleParameters.description: The complete geometry, uncertainty, ordering and transition-gap policy. Position input is evaluated only when the committed evidence has exactly one position; the service does not select a source implicitly.

RuleDefinition.description: Reviewed rule definition. The acting principal is retained privately. Saving a definition evaluates it against the Thing's committed evidence in the same commit, and each later materialisation of that Thing evaluates it again.

SaveRuleDefinitionRequest.description: Binds one closed heartbeat, battery, motion or geofence policy to an existing Thing. The service assigns the policy revision from the commit generation. Kind and Thing are immutable for an ID; a battery rule requires a declared numeric Property in the same unit. At most eight definitions may refer to one Thing. A deleted ID can be reused only with its original kind and Thing.

Alert.description: Alert for one recorded rule event. Its ID sorts newest first. Only a live, unacknowledged alert can be acknowledged; acknowledgement records a pseudonymous actor and time, changes no rule state and dispatches nothing.

event.description: Reviewed rule event. Capture IDs, evidence IDs and digests of private observations, samples, bundles, facts and transport decisions are never present.

thing_id.description: The Thing whose service rule definition produced this alert, or null for host-managed and event-only rules.
